entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Remove cast to concrete `IJSRuntime` implementations and instead register the implementations specifically. #65597
  • ResourceCollectionProvider leaks an `IJSObjectReference`. #65596
  • Perf regression: https, json, mvc #65594
  • Perf regression: https, json, json #65593
  • Perf improvement: kestrel-header-symbols #65592
  • Blazor SSR: enhanced form not working inside a dialog #65584
  • Perf regression: mTls-handshakes-kestrel #65583
  • Perf regression: https, kestrel-hostheader-mismatch, tls-handshakes-kestrel #65582
  • Request Browser-Testing Dependencies Update #65572

Closed

  • ASP.NET Core apps stop working on IIS after removing .NET Core 2.2.2 using dotnet-core-uninstall tool #65508

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix CancellationTokenSource leak in SpaProxy.PerformProxyRequest #65598
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Return distinct error for JSON null body instead of 'non-empty request body' #65595
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Fix rewrite maps not resolved in action URL #65591
    community-contribution, area-middleware
  • Fix ClientErrorMapping 500 title to match RFC 9110 #65590
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Fix AccessTokenHttpClient to catch HttpError 401 and retry with new token #65589
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Disable scheduled workflows in forks #65588
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • [release/9.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `56efe39` to `73a63ea` #65587
    area-infrastructure, 9.0.x
  • [release/8.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `56efe39` to `73a63ea` #65586
    area-infrastructure, 8.0.x
  • Compose multiple IClaimsTransformation registrations sequentially #65585
    area-auth, community-contribution
  • Fix ShallowCopy DateFormatString side effect overriding DateFormatHandling #65580
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Always include Vary: Accept-Encoding for compressible responses #65579
    community-contribution, area-middleware
  • Preserve IOutboundParameterTransformer on optional route constraints #65578
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Initialize PartialTagHelper.ViewData to support view-data-* prefix attributes #65577
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • Fix UpdatePasswordHash virtual method not called consistently #65576
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Fix User Secrets crash on case-different duplicate keys #65575
    area-commandlinetools, community-contribution
  • Fix InputBase parse failure triggering unnecessary field validation #65574

  • Fix FieldIdentifier.GetHashCode() NullReferenceException for default struct #65573

    area-networking, 11.0-preview3

    area-mvc, community-contribution
